name: Nha Trang
provinceNote: Nha Trang is a city in Khánh Hòa. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 joins the former Ninh Thuận province into Khánh Hòa, keeps that name, and prints 8,555.86 km² and 2,243,554 people. The new provincial governments operate from 1 July 2025.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: A beach city on the south-central coast, with a long city beach and a bay full of islands. Swim on the 7 km Tran Phu beach, take boat trips to the islands, visit the Cham towers of Po Nagar, and eat grilled pork rolls and clay-mould rice cakes. Two days suits beach lovers and families.
fee: No single city ticket. A beach ticket was not printed. Check on arrival.
getThere: Cam Ranh airport is south of the city. The train station is in the centre. Minutes were not printed.
seoTitle: Nha Trang travel guide — beach, towers, and the bay
seoDescription: Nha Trang’s city beach runs seven kilometres on Trần Phú. The AIP places Cam Ranh 27 km from the centre. Vietnam Tourism says about 30 km. Dry months are January to August.
intro: The day starts on the city sand. Vietnam Tourism calls Trần Phú a seven-kilometre beach and treats that shore as the daytime beach. After dark the same sand is the walk. The night market is the 137 m street behind 46 Trần Phú.

Po Nagar sits about 2 km north of the centre, in both the provincial digital guide and the provincial tourism department. The seated white Buddha is at Long Sơn, 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Vietnam Tourism and the tourism bureau name nineteen islands. Hòn Tre is the cable crossing. Hòn Mun is the swim shore.

The two airport distances both stay. The AIP places Cam Ranh 27 km from the centre of Nha Trang, the city to the north. Vietnam Tourism says about 30 km south. The minutes were not printed. The station is in the centre. The street of the station was not printed.
gettingAround: From the airport, Vietnam Tourism names shuttles, taxis, and ride-hailing. It does not name a fare. Ride minutes inside the city were not printed. Po Nagar is about 2 km north. The tourism bureau measures the cable to Hòn Tre at 3,320 m.

The railway timetable puts Nha Trang at km 1315 from Hà Nội and km 411 from Sài Gòn. Southbound from Hà Nội the five trains run 24 hours 57 minutes to 28 hours 3 minutes. Southbound from Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 13 minutes to 11 hours. Northbound to Đà Nẵng is 9 hours 30 minutes to 11 hours 1 minute. Southbound to Sài Gòn is 7 hours 48 minutes to 10 hours 23 minutes. Northbound from Sài Gòn is 7 hours 16 minutes to 8 hours 43 minutes. Southbound from Tuy Hòa is 2 hours 4 minutes to 2 hours 44 minutes. Northbound to Tuy Hòa is 2 hours 6 minutes to 2 hours 19 minutes on the four trains that print a time. One northbound train leaves the Tuy Hòa cell blank. A station fare was not printed.

stayAreas.name: Trần Phú
stayAreas.summary: The city sand and the hotel row. The night market is behind 46 Trần Phú.

eat: The provincial digital guide names nem nướng from Ninh Hòa, bún cá from Ninh Hòa, and the night-market stalls behind 46 Trần Phú. Bánh căn is the clay-mold rice cake, with squid, shrimp, or egg.

Chợ Đầm and Chợ Xóm Mới name the market bowls. A Báo Khánh Hòa list adds gỏi cá mai, bánh canh cá dầm, and the other Khánh Hòa dishes it names with a town. Vinpearl Harbour, the two Vincom plazas, and Nha Trang Center name the restaurant doors. Check on arrival.
interestsBody: Use the city in this order. Swim or walk Trần Phú. Eat the Ninh Hòa dishes the provincial digital guide names. Cross to Hòn Tre or swim at Hòn Mun. Climb to the Cham towers and the white Buddha if the day still has light.
The night is the sand and the walking street, not a second beach. The island stay Vietnam Tourism names for families is Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay, on Hòn Tre.

faqs.a: Vietnam Tourism and the tourism bureau both print a dry season from January to August and rain from September to December. The tourism bureau prints an average of 26°C. A storm-closure calendar was not printed.
The AIP says Cam Ranh is 27 km from the centre of Nha Trang, with the city to the north. Vietnam Tourism says about 30 km south. The ride in minutes was not printed.

faqs.q: What are the Po Nagar hours and the ticket?
faqs.a: The provincial digital guide prints 06:00–17:30 and no ticket. The provincial tourism department prints 08:00–18:00 and 22,000 VND a person a visit. From 6 to 11 May 2026 Khánh Hòa police print free entry for the festival.

season.label: January to August
season.note: Vietnam Tourism and the tourism bureau both call January to August the dry season and September to December the rainy season. The tourism bureau prints an average of 26°C for the bay. The 2025 sea cultural-tourism festival ran 7 June–9 July. A 2026 sea-festival date was not printed. The heritage department puts Po Nagar’s annual festival at lunar 20–23 of month 3. The 2026 police notice prints 6–11 May, lunar 19–25.
